add_point.description: Create a free or construction point.

move_point.description: Move an existing point to new coordinates.

add_line.description: Create a straight segment between two points.

add_curve.description: Create a cubic Bézier curve through four control points.

add_arc.description: Create a circular arc through three points: start, end and a point on the arc.

add_circle.description: Create a circle from a centre point and a rim point; the radius is their distance.

add_construction_line.description: Create a reference-only line that never becomes a cut edge.

set_construction.description: Mark an entity as construction geometry or convert it back to a cut edge.

delete_entity.description: Remove an entity and any constraints referencing it.

add_constraint.description: Attach a geometric constraint to one or more entities. A distance without a value is a driven dimension; a distance with a reference follows another dimension.

update_constraint.description: Change a dimensional constraint value, reference or dimension presentation. Null clears a distance to driven; reference null unlinks and keeps the current value.

remove_constraint.description: Detach a constraint from the sketch.

add_seam_allowance.description: Attach a seam allowance (mm) to a cut line or curve edge.

remove_seam_allowance.description: Detach the seam allowance from an edge.

set_seam_allowance.description: Change the width or side of an attached seam allowance (mm).

add_corner_round.description: Round a corner between two lines, trimming both to a tangent arc while keeping the sharp corner as construction geometry.

set_corner_round_radius.description: Change the radius of a corner round and regenerate its tangent points and arc.

remove_corner_round.description: Restore a rounded corner: delete the arc and derived points and return both lines to the sharp corner.

solve.description: Rebuild the sketch by running the constraint solver.
